archive.export.title: Project archive
archive.export.intro: Copy this whole project to another Lific instance. The archive includes linked files, history, deleted content and author names. It can contain sensitive text no longer visible in the project. Accounts and permissions are not included; author names transfer as text only.
archive.export.untouched: Downloading leaves this project untouched. Importing creates a private project, never a merge.
archive.export.confirm: I understand this archive includes history and deleted content.

archive.import.title: Import project archive
archive.import.adminOnly: Only a signed-in instance admin can import a project archive.
archive.import.done.title: {identifier} imported
archive.import.done.private: The new project is private. You are its lead. The source project is unchanged.
archive.import.done.unresolvedBody: These references point outside the archive. Review them before relying on the imported links.
archive.import.done.showingFirst: Showing the first {count}. The full report is retained with the project archive provenance.
archive.import.intro: Create a private project from a Lific archive. You become its lead. Accounts and permissions do not transfer; imported author names are text only.
archive.import.noMerge: The source stays untouched. The archive's project identifier must be unused here: import never merges or overwrites a project.
archive.import.limits: Up to {compressed} compressed, {expanded} expanded. Larger archives need the CLI.
archive.import.confirm: I understand this imports linked files, history and deleted content that may contain sensitive information.
archive.import.processingNote: Once processing starts, it cannot be canceled. You can return to this page to see the result. If the connection is lost, check the project list before importing again.

publish.title: Public view
publish.state.on: This project's current issues and pages are readable by anyone, with no account.
publish.state.off: Off. Only people with access to this project can see its issues and pages.
publish.stableAddress: The address stays the same. Turning public access off and on again brings this exact link back.
publish.turnOffNote: Closes the link immediately. Copies people already downloaded stay downloaded.
publish.warn.title: Publishing makes existing content public, not just future content.
publish.warn.content: Every current issue and page in this project, including full descriptions, labels, modules and folders.
publish.warn.comments: Every comment on those issues and pages, shown with the commenter's display name.
publish.warn.files: Every file attached to those issues, pages and comments, downloadable by anyone.
publish.warn.private: Plans, history, deleted items, usernames and your member list stay private. Nobody needs an account or a password, and there is no secret in the link, so search engines can find it. Turning this back off closes the link but cannot recall anything already downloaded.
publish.acknowledge: I've reviewed this project's issues, pages, comments and attachments, and they can be public.

projectSettings.archive.body: Compresses the project into a single file on the server and removes it from Lific. Nothing is lost: an instance admin can unarchive it from Settings, Instance.

archive.confirm.after.one: issue, pages, plans, and attachments disappear for everyone until it is unarchived. It comes back private, with its members and history. Page revision history, saved views, and repository bindings are not kept.
archive.confirm.after.other: issues, pages, plans, and attachments disappear for everyone until it is unarchived. It comes back private, with its members and history. Page revision history, saved views, and repository bindings are not kept.
